name: ais-vision-systems_post-result-daymsa_en_2026-10-29
copy: Daymsa estimates it cut the time and people it spent on quality inspection by 95%, after installing AIS Vision Systems label and cap inspection on its packaging line. Three cameras check the containers on the line: the cap thread, the label, the barcode and the variable data. Download the case study

shots.text: less time and fewer people on quality inspection
shots.note: Daymsa’s estimate. Case study on aisvision.com, 2020.
